Hello Yale AI Club,

For your request for 20 CC-HOOD-NAVY hoodies in size M, a proposed quote is $50 per hoodie ($1,000 total). This is a proposed price and is not approved or confirmed. Our current records show 8 size-M units on hand, 12 fewer than requested, so we cannot confirm availability for the full quantity. No delivery date or additional stock timing is confirmed.

Please note this message is an unsent draft pending human review.

Campus Customs

pending.note: Proposals move no money. Approving a payment executes it; approving a purchase or quote only authorizes it (nothing is ordered or sent).

cash.source: cash_accounts table (stored balance after executed payments and executed purchases only)

not_counted_as_cash.note: Information only. Proposals and approved-but-unexecuted purchases move no money; purchase figures are estimates; quotes add no revenue (R6). The balance changes only when a person executes a payment (by approving it) or executes an approved purchase.

available.note: Computed, not stored. Invoice and rent payments may use actual cash minus approved unexecuted payments; purchases may use that minus approved unexecuted purchases (purchases yield to obligations). Commitments are never deducted from the stored balance.

audit.note: The JSON trail and the SQLite databases cannot be committed atomically together. Gaps are detected here and reconciled from audit.db and the working copy's reset stamp, never assumed.
